The application stands disposed of.
This is a petition filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 425/2022 dated 27.06.2022 registered at PS Moti Nagar under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.

The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 08.12.2022 before the learned Principal Judge,
Family Court, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, pursuant to which a total sum of Rs. 2,25,000/- was to be paid to respondent No.2.

entities.text:
Principal Judge,
Family Court, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Out of Rs. 2,25,000/-, a sum of Rs. 1,50,000/- has already been paid to respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs. 75,000/- has been paid by the petitioner to the respondent No.2 vide DD No. 428469 dated 09.01.2023 drawn on Punjab National Bank.
The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by Mr. RK Kohli, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Sunrinder Pal Singh Kalra, learned counsel and SI Kailash, PS Moti Nagar.

sentences.text: The parties state that they have arrived at the aforesaid settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.
In view of the aforesaid, the FIR No. 425/2022 dated 27.06.2022 registered at PS Moti Nagar under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
The petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
JASMEET SINGH, J FEBRUARY 15, 2023 /
